chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hasan Ali ibn Asbat al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdillah from Hamzah ibn Humran, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Who inherited the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)?' He said: 'Fatima inherited him the household goods, the crops, and everything that was his.'
ai.seo_question: What did Fatima inherit from the Prophet Muhammad according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the specific material inheritance of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her), including movable household goods (*matāʿ al-bayt*) and agricultural produce (*al-khurth*), which Shia scholars often cite to demonstrate her unique status and the distinct nature of her inheritance compared to the general rules applied to others. The emphasis on 'all that he had' underscores the completeness of her claim to the Prophet's worldly assets, a point of discussion in debates regarding the exclusivity of her inheritance rights versus the broader community.
